messages:
Ravi: Quick plan for a pricing page experiment tied to the webinar. Goals: clearer FAQ + benchmark blurb, calc that shows baseline vs optimized (batching + quant), and clean lead routing by UTM. Need takes on routing and CTA copy.

Sofia: For routing, capture utm_source and utm_campaign in lead payload. If utm_source=webinar, mark webinar_interest=true so SDRs prioritize.

Ben: Calculator UX: show two columns "Baseline (no batching)" vs "Optimized (batching + quant)" with percent savings. Short note on assumptions and a toggle for "include quantization".

Lina: Tier naming suggestion: Launch / Optimize / Scale / Enterprise Cloud. Add one-line descriptors to map to Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

Ravi: Nice. Routing rules draft:
- result >= $2k OR selects Scale/Enterprise Cloud -> AE lead (tag with utm).
- book-demo checkbox -> calendar draft + AE_high_priority.
- else -> marketing lead -> 7-day nurture.

Sofia: Also pre-check "notify me about webinar" for users landing from webinar UTM. And collect email + company size on CTA.

Ben: Events to send: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_run, pricing_calc_toggle_quant, pricing_calc_compare_view, pricing_calc_cta_click, pricing_lead_created, pricing_utm. Will map to Amplitude and GA.

Lina: FAQ updates: short non-technical blurb on "how quantization affects output quality" with link to full benchmark. Add "Which deployment is right for me?" with 3 bullet scenarios.

Ravi: CTA copy variants to A/B: "Calculate your expected bill", "See optimized price with batching", "Compare cost scenarios". Webinar traffic should default to the second.

OpsBot: scheduled reminder -> "Staging pricing-webinar build deployed to /staging/pricing-webinar. Run smoke tests: calc snapshot, utm capture, lead routing. Report results by EOD Wed." :gear:

Sofia: I'll prep the webinar follow-up and nurture emails. Ben, can you wire the Amplitude dashboard to show calc variant funnels + utm cohorts?

Ben: Yep. I'll share the dashboard link here when ready.

Ravi: Timeline: push to staging today, smoke test tomorrow, soft-launch Thu to 10% traffic with webinar UTM pinned. Full flip after 72h if KPIs hold (calc_cta_ctr, lead_rate, webinar_signups). I'll post the playbook doc and the sample lead JSON once it's up.
